title: She Had No Criminal History & Decides To Do This
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On February 28, 2022, an officer observed a speeding silver vehicle in Genoa City, WI. While attempting to catch up, it pulled into a parking lot and struck four parked vehicles. The officer held them at gunpoint until they decided to flee the traffic stop and the visual was lost. The suspect vehicle was soon discovered by deputies. Stop sticks were deployed and a PIT maneuver was utilized to disable the vehicle.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
